name: Starful Gothic
tagline: White pencil on a night sky, hand-drawn
lineage: Bureau's Starry Sidekick, from the night sky of timothyvlangas.com, grown gothic.
story: Outside, at night, with a white pencil. The sky is the page and everything on it is drawn rather than printed — a front is its outline, not its fill. It keeps the early-internet cosiness of the old site: hand-lettered headings, stars scattered where there is room, two colours of light (a blue and a green) and nothing else glowing. Gothic in the cathedral sense — dark, vertical, ornamented by line — not in the costume sense.
principles: The line is the form: outlines nearly opaque, fills near-black. If you can't draw it with one pencil, it doesn't belong.
No shadows — nothing casts one at night. Depth comes from line weight, never from blur.
It is night and nothing else. There is no light mode to switch to.
Exactly two colours act: the blue and the green. Everything else differs by a whisper of blue or green in the black.
do: Outline surfaces in the near-opaque white line.
Scatter stars in empty space — they are punctuation, not wallpaper.
Let headings feel hand-lettered: a humanist face, generously sized.
dont: No box-shadows, ever — and never the value none where a shadow composes; write a zero shadow.
No filled white surfaces; white is for lines and text only.
No third accent colour, however tempting.

voice.tone: Playful but quiet, like notes traded after midnight. It can joke; it never shouts.

display.stack: Optima, 'Gill Sans', 'Gill Sans MT', 'Avenir Next', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif

body.stack: Optima, 'Gill Sans', 'Gill Sans MT', 'Avenir Next', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif

motion.character: Drift, not snap — things move the way slow constellations do.

texture.notes: Star-speckled night checker. Future asset hook: the site's hand-drawn GIFs (persona, sun, cassettes) as optional ornaments.

notes: Seeded from Bureau's Starry Sidekick (web/js/look.js + docs/STYLES.md); the name here is the aesthetic's own. Shadows are stored as zero shadows, never none — half of Bureau's border slots compose var(--shadow) into a list where none is illegal, and that lesson travels.
